items.prompt: An estimated average return has a narrow 95% mean interval. What would you check before treating it as reliable evidence?
items.modelAnswer: Check sampling/selection and time order, the fixed estimand, dependence, tails/finite moments, estimated versus known scale, multiplicity, costs and regime changes. A mean interval is not a guarantee of a profitable next observation or an approved trade.

criteria.text: Interprets repeated coverage, not guaranteed profit.
Checks assumptions, time order and selection.
Separates a mean from future individual outcomes.
